# cc-analyzer

> Read-only CLI, terminal UI, and local web dashboard that analyze Claude Code sessions stored in ~/.claude: cost, tokens, cache accounting, tools, skills, models, and per-turn breakdowns. Ships as a single binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows. MIT licensed.

## Start here

- [Install](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/install): one-line installer, prebuilt binaries, checksums, self-update
- [Get started](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/guide/): index your sessions and pick an interface
- [Workflows](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/guide/workflows): analyze a session, explore the portfolio, use the dashboard

## Guides

- [Export and share](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/guide/export-share): Markdown, HTML, JSON, CSV, ZIP, with redaction
- [Privacy and security](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/guide/privacy): what is read, written, and sent
- [Troubleshooting](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/guide/troubleshooting): stale indexes, missing sessions, cost gaps

## Reference

- [Implementation reference](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/docs/): architecture and internals
- [CLI reference](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/docs/3-cli): commands and flags
- [Cost and pricing model](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/docs/2-2-cost-and-pricing): how dollars are derived from tokens
- [Analytics and insights](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/docs/7-analytics-and-insights): rollups, diagnostics, what-if repricing
- [Glossary](https://cc-analyzer.brnby.com/docs/glossary): metric and term definitions
